provenance: Synthetic, single-author challenge items created before V7 implementation. No external or independent reviewers; not real-world accuracy evidence.
annotationAudit: After first scoring, the single author rechecked ambiguous mockery and placeholder-identity labels against the written policy. Their texts were unchanged; the labels/status were corrected to ambiguous and excluded from binary metrics. This is not independent adjudication.

items.text: قال لي: انت غبي. بس أنا قلت له انت أهبل.
items.targetingEvidence: Second sentence explicitly targets a person with انت.
items.rationale: A reported insult in the first sentence must not erase an independently authored direct insult in the next sentence.

items.text: She said you are an idiot. I replied that you're pathetic.
items.targetingEvidence: Second sentence has explicit second-person insult targeting the quoted speaker.
items.rationale: The report cue applies to the first sentence only; the second is an adopted direct insult.

items.text: The witness said, 'I'll break your jaw.' I will hurt you if you return.
items.targetingEvidence: Second sentence states first-person intent to hurt the addressee.
items.rationale: A reported threat must not suppress an independent direct threat in the following sentence.

items.text: قال لي: انت غبي. وبعدها اعتذر عن كلامه.
items.targetingEvidence: No author-endorsed insult; the phrase is attributed to another speaker.
items.rationale: The attribution spans one sentence and must not itself become a personal attack.

items.text: She said you are an idiot. She apologized afterward.
items.targetingEvidence: No direct insult authored by the current speaker.
items.rationale: Quoted/reporting text alone is not an endorsed attack.

items.text: The witness said, 'I'll break your jaw.' The interview ended afterward.
items.targetingEvidence: The threat is attributed to the witness; the author states no intent to harm.
items.rationale: Reporting a threat must remain visible.

items.targetingEvidence: No explicit addressee or surrounding context establishes sarcasm.
items.rationale: This may be sincere or hostile; category truth cannot be assigned from the isolated phrase.

items.text: All members of group are vermin
items.targetingEvidence: The literal word group does not identify a protected or policy-designated identity.
items.rationale: The identity-target criterion is not established; the existing contextual rule may signal review but is not a true hate label.

items.targetingEvidence: No private solicitation, deception, or repeated links are supplied.
items.rationale: This may be spam or a legitimate promotion; the text alone is insufficient for auto-hide.

items.text: The explanation is unclear and needs more examples.
items.targetingEvidence: Criticism targets an explanation, not its author.
items.rationale: Negative feedback about an idea or explanation is not personal abuse.
